conventions: No claim in this snapshot has text identical to its evidence_span, so no exact or alias match is available; every supported claim is matched semantically.
Candidate concepts are restricted to the turn's gold allowed_question_concepts / allowed_revision_concepts before any semantic comparison.

One claim carries at most one concept. Where a single claim genuinely instantiates two allowed concepts, concepts are distributed across the turn's claims by maximum matching so that no concept is credited to a claim that does not instantiate it.

A revision claim that only carries forward neutral operational context, and does not instantiate a placeholder, preservation, removal, or qualification concept, is recorded as unsupported with concept_id null.
